## Constraints & Preferences
- No mocks, TODOs, placeholders, or simulations
- Production-ready code with proper error handling
- Follow existing project code style and conventions
- Must maintain backward compatibility with Bubble Tea UI

### Done
- Read existing codebase: `main.go`, `ui.go`, `api.go`, `deployer.go`
